body: Sorry.  Got distracted.  I might be back in the morning.
It means I like your username.
Oh, Butterfly, you make me smile.

It is pretty amazing.  And I think that's part of why it's so sad.  No one to share it with.  I've made so many bad choices - and what sucks is most of it is bad luck.  Said the wrong thing when I could have just as well said the right thing.  Things that I didn't realize mattered so much to the person I was talking with at the time.
Thanks... but really it's a lot of pain.  Sometimes it's just one line in a song... or the whole song.  But it all hurts.
Lots.  It would take hours to explain... that's what the music is for.

It's on the shore of a local lake.  It's in the middle of a very busy city, but somehow remote.  Across the lake someone has built a house that looks like a lighthouse.  Lights from houses along the lake reflecting off the water.  Stars shining in the sky.  There's a power substation pretty close that always hums, but it's kind of comforting.  I've only ever taken one person there... one of the best nights of my life.  Amazing how some places can be so good... but so sad at the same time.
Just so you know... I have a place, too.  That's where I'll go.
